account.daily_loss: config.max_daily_loss / config.total_capital x Rs 10 lakh (realised net, new entries only)
account.futures_margin: lots x lot x price x config.ai_agent_future_margin_pct (15 %) ~ SPAN+exposure; index orders capped at config.max_futures_order_value
account.no_stop_fallback: Rs 1 lakh notional (stocks), spec lots (index futures), 1 lot (stock futures)
account.priority: fill time; ties by previous-session traded value (desc); exits before entries at the same minute

amendment: The user's instruction 'Risk 1:3' (1:3 risk-reward bracket on every grid combo; live strategies keep their own exits with a report-only 1:3 comparison) arrived before this file was written and before any tfgrid result existed; it is part of the plan from the start, not an amendment after results.

controls.use: engine bias check and the empirical luck rate of the account screen; not trials
controls.what: RANDOM entry (seeds 1..10 per timeframe, coin side, 1.5 ATR stop, 1:3) and PLANTED edges (5 / 10 / 20 / 100 % of entries take the side of the next 10 candles' move) through the same engine + account on DISCOVERY, the first 25 stocks

data.universe: today's NIFTY-100 stocks (survivorship-biased) + NIFTY 50 / NIFTY BANK spot minute bars standing in for index futures

engine.entry_events: an entry is the rule's condition turning true on a candle; every event is a candidate with its own outcome; the account picks
engine.fills: decision at candle close, fill at the next 1-minute open +- slippage (2 bps stocks, 1 bps index); stops/targets on every later minute's low/high incl. the fill minute; stop first; gap through the stop fills at the open; target needs one tick through; rule exits at the next minute's open; intraday tfs: no fill at/after 15:15, square-off at the 15:15 open; daily/weekly: overnight, closed at the period's last close; data cut at the period end
engine.index_futures: spot index minute bars stand in for the future (no basis / roll; lab convention), 2026 lots NIFTY 65 / BANKNIFTY 30 on every date
engine.stock_futures: simulated on the cash price with futures costs; lot = nsedata bhavcopy lot of 2026-11-09 used for EVERY date incl. 2016-23 (labelled); no basis/roll

exit_rule.text: 1:3 bracket on every combo: stop = the rule's own initial stop (none: 1.5 x ATR(14) of its own timeframe), target = fill +- 3 x |fill - stop|; the rule's exit signal, its max hold and the 15:15 intraday square-off still apply, whichever comes first. The textbook exits are NOT run as extra variants. Natives: the same wrapper on their own entries (no stop: 1.5 x the lab's 5-minute ATR intraday / daily ATR(14) positional). Exception: the live strategies + AUC-FADE-2PCT keep their own exits; a 1:3 version of them is report-only (no trial).

live_strategies.accounts: auction agent (AUC-FADE, MIS), attention agent (SWING-ATTN-ON-3X, stock futures on cash), strangle agent (VRP winged, 2 lots); each Rs 10 lakh with its config.validated_* limits (Rs 1 lakh per stock trade, max gross Rs 10 lakh, its daily loss stop), own exits; both eras; report only (already judged)
live_strategies.rr_variant: report-only 1:3 bracket on the same trades (AUC-FADE: 1.5 x 5-minute ATR(14) stop; ATTN: 1.5 x daily ATR(14); strangle: the defined risk is the wing loss, a 3x target exceeds the maximum profit (the credit): not applicable, identical)

adx_di.desc: ADX(14) > 25 and +DI crosses above -DI (long) / -DI above +DI (short); exit on the DI cross back

aroon_25.desc: Aroon(25): Aroon-up crosses above Aroon-down (long) / below (short); exit on the opposite cross

bb_breakout.desc: Close crosses above the upper Bollinger band(20, 2) (long) / below the lower (short); exit on a close back through the middle band

bb_reversion.desc: Close crosses below the lower Bollinger band(20, 2) (long) / above the upper (short); exit on a close back through the middle band

cci_20.desc: Lambert CCI(20): crosses above +100 (long) / below -100 (short); exit when it crosses back through 0

cs_engulfing.desc: bull_engulfing (long) / bear_engulfing (short), candles.py textbook detectors with the lab's prior-trend rule; max hold 10 candles
cs_engulfing.own_stop: beyond the pattern extreme, at least 0.3 x ATR(14) (the lab's plan)

cs_hammer_star.desc: hammer (long) / shooting_star (short), candles.py textbook detectors with the lab's prior-trend rule; max hold 10 candles
cs_hammer_star.own_stop: beyond the pattern extreme, at least 0.3 x ATR(14) (the lab's plan)

cs_harami.desc: bull_harami (long) / bear_harami (short), candles.py textbook detectors with the lab's prior-trend rule; max hold 10 candles
cs_harami.own_stop: beyond the pattern extreme, at least 0.3 x ATR(14) (the lab's plan)

cs_marubozu.desc: bull_marubozu (long) / bear_marubozu (short), candles.py textbook detectors with the lab's prior-trend rule; max hold 10 candles
cs_marubozu.own_stop: beyond the pattern extreme, at least 0.3 x ATR(14) (the lab's plan)

cs_piercing_dark.desc: piercing_line (long) / dark_cloud (short), candles.py textbook detectors with the lab's prior-trend rule; max hold 10 candles
cs_piercing_dark.own_stop: beyond the pattern extreme, at least 0.3 x ATR(14) (the lab's plan)

cs_soldiers_crows.desc: three_white_soldiers (long) / three_black_crows (short), candles.py textbook detectors with the lab's prior-trend rule; max hold 10 candles
cs_soldiers_crows.own_stop: beyond the pattern extreme, at least 0.3 x ATR(14) (the lab's plan)

cs_stars.desc: morning_star (long) / evening_star (short), candles.py textbook detectors with the lab's prior-trend rule; max hold 10 candles
cs_stars.own_stop: beyond the pattern extreme, at least 0.3 x ATR(14) (the lab's plan)

cs_three_inside.desc: three_inside_up (long) / three_inside_down (short), candles.py textbook detectors with the lab's prior-trend rule; max hold 10 candles
cs_three_inside.own_stop: beyond the pattern extreme, at least 0.3 x ATR(14) (the lab's plan)

cs_three_outside.desc: three_outside_up (long) / three_outside_down (short), candles.py textbook detectors with the lab's prior-trend rule; max hold 10 candles
cs_three_outside.own_stop: beyond the pattern extreme, at least 0.3 x ATR(14) (the lab's plan)

cs_tweezer.desc: tweezer_bottom (long) / tweezer_top (short), candles.py textbook detectors with the lab's prior-trend rule; max hold 10 candles
cs_tweezer.own_stop: beyond the pattern extreme, at least 0.3 x ATR(14) (the lab's plan)

donchian_20_10.desc: Turtle system 1: close above the prior 20-candle high (long) / below the low (short); exit on a close beyond the prior 10-candle opposite extreme

ema_20_50.desc: EMA20 crosses EMA50; exit on the opposite cross

ema_9_21.desc: EMA9 crosses EMA21: long on the up-cross, short on the down-cross; exit on the opposite cross

heikin_ashi.desc: Heikin-Ashi candle turns green (long) / red (short); exit on the colour flip

ichimoku_tk.desc: Ichimoku(9,26,52): Tenkan crosses Kijun above the cloud (long) / below it (short); exit on the opposite Tenkan-Kijun cross

inside_bar_brk.desc: Inside bar: the candle before is inside its mother candle; a close above the mother's high (long) / below its low (short); max hold 10 candles
inside_bar_brk.own_stop: the other side of the mother candle

keltner_20_2.desc: Close crosses above EMA20 + 2 x ATR(10) (long) / below EMA20 - 2 x ATR(10) (short); exit on a close back through EMA20

macd_signal.desc: MACD(12,26,9) line crosses its signal line; exit on the opposite cross

macd_zero.desc: MACD(12,26) line crosses zero; exit on the opposite cross

mfi_14.desc: Money flow index(14) crosses up through 20 (long, exit up through 80) / down through 80 (short, exit down through 20)

nr7_brk.desc: NR7: the candle before has the narrowest range of the last 7; a close above its high (long) / below its low (short); max hold 10 candles
nr7_brk.own_stop: the other side of the NR7 candle

psar.desc: Parabolic SAR(0.02, 0.02, 0.2) flips below / above the close; exit on the flip
psar.own_stop: the SAR value at the signal candle

px_ema50.desc: Close crosses EMA50 (Varsity); exit on the opposite cross

roc_12.desc: Rate of change(12) crosses zero; exit on the opposite cross

rsi2_connors.desc: Connors RSI(2): RSI2 < 10 above SMA200 (long, exit close > SMA5) / RSI2 > 90 below SMA200 (short, exit close < SMA5)

rsi_30_70.desc: RSI(14) crosses up through 30 (long, exit when it crosses up through 70) / down through 70 (short, exit when it crosses down through 30)

sma_50_200.desc: SMA50 crosses SMA200 (golden / death cross); exit on the opposite cross

stoch_14_3_3.desc: Slow stochastic(14,3,3): %K crosses above %D below 20 (long, exit %K crosses up through 80) / below %D above 80 (short, exit %K crosses down through 20)

supertrend_10_3.desc: Supertrend(10, 3) turns green / red; exit on the flip
supertrend_10_3.own_stop: the Supertrend line at the signal candle

td9_setup.desc: TD Sequential setup: 9 consecutive closes below (above) the close 4 candles earlier -> long (short) at the 9th; max hold 10 candles
td9_setup.own_stop: the lowest low (highest high) of the 9 setup candles

vol_breakout_20.desc: Close above the prior 20-candle high on volume > 2 x its 20-candle average (long; mirror short); exit on a close beyond the prior 10-candle opposite extreme

williams_r_14.desc: Williams %R(14) crosses up through -80 (long, exit up through -20) / down through -20 (short, exit down through -80)

protocol.dsr: trials.dsr on the stage-2 daily account P&L (non-annualised daily SR, skew, kurtosis): N = full trial count of trials_v2.csv after appending this grid (all eras), and the fair N = combos in this grid; V[SR] = robust (1.4826 MAD)^2 of the grid's stage-1 daily Sharpes, floored at 1/(T-1)
protocol.excess: long-biased survivors: net minus the same notional's NIFTY move over each trade, and account return vs NIFTY buy-and-hold
protocol.final: one look per passer (net > 0 and PF >= 1.05), tfgrid final ledger; never for failures
protocol.proven: stage-1 pass AND FINAL confirmed AND stage-2 pass AND DSR(full N) >= 0.95
protocol.stage1: protocol.screen on the account's DISCOVERY trades (gates unchanged: H1 & H2 net > 0, PF >= 1.15, >= 150 intraday / 60 positional trades, top symbol <= 35 %; index combos exempt from the symbol gate as the lab's index futures)
protocol.stage2: protocol_min_oos.judge gates on 2016-01-01..2023-11-09 (H1 2016-19, H2 2020-23, PF >= 1.15, >= 150 / 60 trades per half, top symbol <= 35 %); dirty-link rule applied to candidates before the account; every stage-1 passer, once
protocol.trials_ledger: every combo evaluated is appended (era 2023-26 stage tfgrid-screen / tfgrid-final; era 2016-23 stage tfgrid-oos); backup taken first

statement: Written BEFORE any tfgrid result was computed. Code + this file are committed before the run.
